website_summary.name: BarberShop Manager Pro
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and organized layout with a snowflake animation background, designed for managing barbers and services efficiently.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a professional and user-friendly design with a soft beige background and subtle snow animations creating a winter ambiance. It includes sections for "Our Barbers" and "Our Services," each displaying cards with details such as names, specialties, available times, prices, and booking options. The "Our Barbers" section allows users to view barber profiles, including their specialties and available appointment slots. Similarly, the "Our Services" section lists various hair-related services with durations, prices, and booking buttons. A search bar is provided in both sections for easy filtering. The "Appointments" section indicates current bookings, though it currently shows no appointments. The overall layout is responsive and visually appealing, ensuring a pleasant user experience.
website_summary.functionality:
The website offers several key functionalities:
- Users can browse through available barbers and their specialties via the "Our Barbers" section.
- Users can explore different services offered by the barbershop, including their duration and cost, in the "Our Services" section.
- There are options to book appointments directly from the barber and service cards.
- Administrators can add new barbers and services using the respective "Add Barber" and "Add Service" buttons.
- The site supports sending WhatsApp notifications, although this feature isn't explicitly shown in the screenshots but implied by the management context.
- A search functionality within each section helps users quickly find specific barbers or services.
